notes.title: Update #3 - Difficulty Levels
notes.content: [h3]Welcome Survivors![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Game Update #3[/b][/h3][p]- Added Difficulty Settings when starting a new game, not dropping items on death is also an option[/p][p]- New late game weapon: Spectral Shotgun[/p][p]- Crafting Tab Reworked: when interacting with a crafting station, only the station's recipes will be displayed[/p][p]- Interaction HUD will properly display the name of crafting stations[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/3a7aaf646f1a32b8d36b3ebf7db5f37e95a88e02.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The Dev's recommendation:[/h3][list][*][p][b]World: Easy & Character: Softcore[/b] is best suited for those who want to focus more on exploring the world and worry less about the danger level of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]World: Normal & Character: Normal[/b] is the standard experience where enemies are a real danger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]World: Expert[/b] is just brutal. Most enemies will kill you with two shots, maybe more if you equip the right gear. Combined with [b]Character Difficulty: Softcore[/b] it will make the experience a bit smoother since you can get right back to action not having to worry about retrieving lost items. But combined with [b]Character Difficulty: Normal[/b] the player will be heavily punished for every single mistake.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/5pf2r6kScD" style="button"]Discord Server[/url] and tell me about your experience and potential feedback! Have fun![/p]

notes.content:

notes.title: Date Release Announcement & Big Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Wait is Almost Over – Desolated District Release Date Revealed![/h1]

We're thrilled to finally announce the official release date for [b]Desolated District[/b]! Mark your calendars: [b]May 22nd[/b] is the day the full experience goes live.

To celebrate this milestone, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer showcasing new content, updated visuals, and a glimpse at what awaits you in the full game.

[previewyoutube=LM9U1wMx4nQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Final Demo Content Update – Available Now![/h2]

Alongside the release date announcement, we’re also rolling out one last content update for the demo. This update introduces new features, balance tweaks, and fresh content to give players a final taste of what's to come
[list]
[*]Quest System
[*]Biome System
[*]Added the Slime Boss
[*]New Zone: The Slug Nest
[*]New Creature: the Hoarder Slug
[*]Total UI Refactor
[*]Metal Tower Parkour reworked
[*]Slime Enemy Balance
[*]New Main Menu Scene
[*]Rooftops small visual changes
[/list]
Your support has meant the world to us. We can’t wait to share the full version with you and see what you build, explore, and survive in [b]Desolated District[/b].

[h3][b]Wishlist[/b] now and stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch day![/h3]

notes.title: Final Demo Update Incoming
notes.content:
[h1]Big things are coming to Desolated District![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that the final demo update will be launching on April 27th on Steam!

[h3]This update is packed with content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New enemies lurking in unexplored corners
[*] A new boss ready to test your skills
[*] New systems to deepen your survival experience

[*] And plenty of overall polish to bring the game world to life

We’ll reveal all the gritty details on launch day so stay tuned.

In the meantime, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/5pf2r6kScD]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks, dev updates, and to chat with fellow survivors.

Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/66db67d356f401094bdec71f2c04ed1cd36c91e0.png[/img]

See you out there, survivor. Stay sharp.

notes.title: Playtest Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]State of the Game and News[/h1]

Hi Survivors!
The preparations for the playtest took longer than expected but we are now closer than ever before!

Here's some new additions to the game:

[h2]The Explorable Tower[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/2524bc55b97e5a7c86249e9a97ca989ffa8cba10.png[/img]
A new area added to the game, presenting new challenges, parkour elements and unique rewards for the worthy daring to explore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/a3a562969504162a96dc94f23414e3da264e04eb.png[/img]

[h2]Armor and Accessories[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/f793cae94f54eae221bfd65110fa47ebc8a6aac5.png[/img]
Customize your build with armor and accessories that provide various bonuses, increase your defense stats and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/5b273bbf92aa09ae7e472253dbe5deb6773ea4f7.png[/img]

[h2]Utility Slot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/cc8670f2354b1b225587281795a885635ae1e018.png[/img]
The Utility Slot is dedicated for utility items such as light sources, shields and who knows what else. This unique slot is basically designed to equip only utility items into the left hand while the right hand can equip anything selected in the inventory hotbar except for utility items.

[h2]Playtest Update[/h2]
Late August the game should be ready for it's first playtest!
In order to participate join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/5pf2r6kScD]Discord Server[/url] where I post even more news about the game and the playtest itself!

See you soon!

notes.title: Playtest Announcement & Game State Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Exciting News: New Playtest Coming Soon! [/b][/h1]
Be among the first to experience these exciting updates in our upcoming playtest! Join the Discord server if you want to participate [url=https://discord.gg/5pf2r6kScD]Desolated District Discord Server[/url] (this is not the Beta)

[h1]Game State Update[/h1]
[h2]Items, Storage & Crafting System[/h2]
Discover new items to craft and explore intricate crafting recipes that will challenge your survival skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/ed9646505d1e1169e1febe5ae7f3a8e2dfc84300.png[/img]

Venture into the dark and gather resources like never before! Explore diverse areas full of valuable materials waiting to be harvested. But beware - danger lurks around every corner.
